scope_summary: Add opt-in Langfuse Cloud tracing to pipeline hooks. PreToolUse:Agent opens spans on subagent spawn; PostToolUse:Agent closes them on return. Spans flushed at Stop hook. All payloads sanitized (truncate + path-redact + secret-redact) before egress. Default OFF; zero behavior change when disabled.
in_scope: Add langfuse npm dep to package.json
Extend hooks/hooks.json PreToolUse:Agent chain with langfuse-hook
Env config: LANGFUSE_ENABLED, LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY, LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY, LANGFUSE_HOST, LANGFUSE_SAMPLE_RATE
Local error log .pipeline/langfuse-errors.jsonl on SDK failure
out_of_scope: Real-time contract verifier extending sentinel-hook (separate future pipeline)
Cross-run aggregation dashboards beyond what Langfuse Cloud UI provides
Telemetry opt-in flow for marketplace end-users (this is maintainer-local)
acceptance_criteria_summary: AC1: With LANGFUSE_ENABLED unset or false, no Langfuse SDK code path is invoked and no network egress occurs
AC2: With mock endpoint configured, every Agent spawn produces a well-formed span (traceId, spanId, parent linkage, duration > 0)
AC3: Sanitizer removes NPM_TOKEN and LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY values from any span payload before egress
AC4: Hook overhead is sub-100ms when LANGFUSE_ENABLED=false
AC5: Langfuse SDK exceptions never propagate to pipeline (exit 0 always; logged to .pipeline/langfuse-errors.jsonl)

design_decisions_locked.D3: Fire-and-forget per hook + langfuse.flush(timeout=3000) at Stop
design_decisions_locked.D5: lib/langfuse-sanitizer.cjs 3-layer: truncate 2000 + paths-to-relative + secrets regex/process.env scan
